title: Mobility API hardening: negative dt validation and pattern-instance aliasing
description: (a) step(dt_us<0) unvalidated: GroupMobility._update_jitter pushes _jitter_elapsed_us negative, max_step goes negative moving members AWAY from targets, and ZeroDivisionError possible on zero-magnitude jitter (mobility.py:379-400); validate dt_us>=0 like the runner clamp. (b) One-pattern-instance-per-group is documented but unenforced: MobilityManager.attach silently aliases, double-stepping a shared group pattern (mobility.py:200-203, :839). Add instance-attach guard or explicit error. Tests for both.
